verdict.rationale: Autumn offers some multi-item operations: multiAttach attaches several plans to a customer in one request, attachLicense assigns licenses to one or more entities, and `atmn push` syncs all features and plans from config in one command. There is no evidence of bulk operations across many customers, such as batch tracking, batch attaching, or bulk balance updates. Missing for 10: bulk or batch endpoints across many customers or events, documented batch limits or semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
